content:
The [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Count days, weeks and months between two dates. Enter your start date and end date and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Count the exact number of days between any two dates — useful for deadlines, countdowns, notice periods and project planning. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Date & Time tools include [Age Calculator](/age-calculator), [Date Calculator](/date-calculator) and [Time Calculator](/time-calculator). People also look for this tool as "date difference calculator", "how many days until", "day counter".

## How to use the Days Between Dates Calculator

Start by picking your start date, then picking your end date. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Pick your start date.
2. Pick your end date.
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Days = (end − start) ÷ 86,400,000 ms. Weekdays exclude Saturdays and Sundays.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. From 1 January to 25 December 2026 is 358 days, or 51 weeks and 1 day. Try the same figures in the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Start date: 2026-01-01, End date: 2026-12-25), the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) returns Days: 358, Weeks + days: 51 weeks 1 days, Weekdays (Mon–Fri): 256, Hours: 8,592. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Add 1 if you want to include both the start and end day.
- Public holidays are not excluded from the weekday count.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does this include the end date?

No — it counts the days between. Add one day to include both endpoints. Try it with your own numbers in the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Are holidays excluded?

Only weekends are excluded from the weekday figure. Try it with your own numbers in the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How do I calculate the number of days between two dates?

Enter the start date and the end date and the calculator counts the days between them. It handles leap years and month lengths for you, so you don't have to count by hand. Try it with your own numbers in the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Days Between Dates Calculator use?

Days = (end − start) ÷ 86,400,000 ms. Weekdays exclude Saturdays and Sundays. You can see it in action in the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Days Between Dates Calculator?

Just Start date and End date. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
